title: report.json (contract 1.x)
description: What every `harness run` and `harness compare` writes. Derived from RunReport in src/types.ts; tests/contract.test.ts fails when the two drift.

schemaVersion.description: Major version of the contract. Refuse a value you do not know.

harnessVersion.description: Same as harness.version; kept for readers of pre-contract reports.

ranAt.description: When the comparison was judged (wall clock, UTC).

now.description: The frozen clock both sides were given (HARNESS_NOW / --now).

provenance.description: Since contract 1.1.0. Where each side's images came from, their registry digests and OCI labels. A side is absent when it was not inspected: migration mode, the live side of post-deploy mode, a capture recorded before 1.1.0.

imageArtefacts.description: Since contract 1.2.0. For each side, and each app, whether the static image artefacts (manifest, sbom, vulns) were collected from the image and, for those that were not, why. A side is absent when its images were not inspected: migration mode, the live side of post-deploy mode, a capture recorded before 1.2.0. What was found is in compare.hunks under the artefacts image-manifest, sbom and vulns.

deployment.description: Since contract 1.3.0. Post-deploy mode, when the deploy said what it deployed (--deployed, --deployed-digests, or the `deployed` dispatch's `production` and `digests`): the digests it reported against the release record of the candidate release mode judged. Advisory: a status other than match adds a reason and turns a PASS into a WARN; it never turns anything into a FAIL and never turns a FAIL into anything.

production.description: The production tag the deploy reported.

status.description: match: every digest the deploy reported is the one recorded, and no app is missing on either side. differs: at least one app is deployed at another digest than the one judged. incomplete: nothing differs, but an app has a digest on one side only. no-record: no release record was found for the release. not-reported: the deploy named a tag but gave no digests.

recorded.description: As recorded when the candidate was judged. Absent without a record.

problems.description: One line per disagreement or gap; empty exactly when status is match. For people.

reasons.description: Why the verdict is what it is, one line each. For people; the wording is not part of the contract.

matches.description: One entry per hunk, with the claim that covers it when one does.

unclaimed.description: Failing hunks no claim covers. These are what gates.

broadUnapproved.description: Broad claims without approvedBy; they gate in release and post-deploy modes.

masksApplied.description: Mask id -> how many times it changed something, both sides summed. 0 means silent.

switchedAt.description: Milliseconds into the load window at which the edge switched to b.

load.description: Present when --load ran on both sides. The samples stay in the captures.

claimHygiene.description: Since 1.2.0. Present whenever the claims file had claims. Informational: never changes the verdict.

claims.description: Claims in the file, stale ones included.

claimedHunks.description: Failing hunks covered by some claim.

hunksPerClaim.description: claimedHunks / claims to two decimals; 0 without claims.

maxHunksPerClaim.description: The most failing hunks any one claim covers.

threshold.description: N: a claim covering more failing hunks than this is flagged (--claim-max-hunks, HARNESS_CLAIM_MAX_HUNKS; default 10).

flags.description: covers-many-hunks: more than threshold hunks. broad-with-approval: a broad claim (artefact * or scope **) that a human approved; allowed, but routine use means claims have become a checkbox.

override.description: Since 1.2.0. Present only when an override of a harness FAIL was requested (--override-reason, --override-by): a recorded event, not a verdict. The verdict stays what the harness decided.

by.description: Who decided (in the workflows, the actor who dispatched the run).

verdict.description: The verdict the harness reached before the override.

applied.description: True when the verdict was fail, so the override changed the exit code from 1 to 0; false when it was not needed.

digests.description: app -> image digest. The apps are the harness's (reader, catalogue, live).

noiseStatus.description: The noise status consulted for the gating decision (noise-status.schema.json); absent when none was supplied or it was waived with --noise skip.

time.description: Since 1.3.0. The time app's image reference; "-" when the side has none (migration mode, a live deployment given no time URL). Absent from a report written before 1.3.0.

summary.description: One line for people, e.g. pulled+verified, or built-from-ref v16.2.0@1a2b3c4d5e6f. Do not parse; read images.*.provenance.

allowedUnsigned.description: Present when --allow-unsigned let the run judge a registry image whose signature was not verified.

ref.description: The image reference as given or expanded; the same string as in sides.

id.description: Local image id (sha256:... of the image config).

digest.description: Registry digest of the manifest (for a multi-arch image, of the index). Only for a pulled image.

revision.description: org.opencontainers.image.revision label: the monorepo commit, as the image states it.

provenance.description: local: present and never pulled, not verified. pulled+verified: pulled and its cosign signature verified by digest against verifiedIdentity. pulled-unverified: pulled, not verified, judged only because of --allow-unsigned. built-from-ref: built on this machine from a monorepo git ref; not the published image. cached (since 1.2.0): restored from the runner's image cache because the registry could not be reached; pulled and verified on the earlier run named by cachedAt, but the tag's freshness is unconfirmed.

verifiedIdentity.description: pulled+verified: the certificate identity regular expression the signature was checked against.

unverifiedReason.description: pulled-unverified: why verification failed. For people.

cachedAt.description: cached: when the cache entry was saved, i.e. the earlier run that pulled and verified the image.

collected.description: False means the artefact was NOT compared: the run says so rather than reporting it clean.

source.description: Collected: where it came from (e.g. cosign attestation, generated by syft, grype 0.9.1). For people.

summary.description: Collected: one line of what was found. For people.

artefact.description: "bus", "image-manifest", "sbom", "vulns", "runtime" and "startup" since contract 1.2.0. A consumer must tolerate an artefact name it does not know.

reason.description: Always present. For a claim that named a rule and gave no reason, the harness writes `Rule NNNN: <title>`.

rule.description: Since 1.3.0. The Rule the claim named; it was in the rules file.

ruleTitle.description: Since 1.3.0. That Rule's title in the rules file; present exactly when `rule` is.
